summary.headline: Planetary Positions and Fixed Stars
summary.text: Astrological positions and configurations of Saturn in Aries, Jupiter in Virgo, and Mars in Leo, with measurements for nearby fixed stars and details of stations, visibility, planetary houses, terms, triangles, exaltations, depressions, decans, faces, and monomoiria. The apparatus cites Bouché-Leclercq’s Astrologie grecque and records corrections from codices V and M.
